commentary.text: 90+8' Cesar Soto Grado is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Cesar Soto Grado didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+6' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) for a tough tackle.
90+3' 1 - 1 What bad luck! Alex Padilla (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into his own net.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Alex Padilla pulls off a great save to deny Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
89' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
89' Suso (Sevilla) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Alex Padilla to dive and make a save.
87' A poor mid-range free-kick by Suso (Sevilla) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
86' Here is a change. Lucien Agoume is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Jesus Navas (Sevilla).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alex Padilla (Ath Bilbao) comes onto the pitch so that Nico Williams can be given a rest.
82' Julen Agirrezabala (Ath Bilbao) expresses his disappointment as he receives a straight red card.
81' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) sends the corner into the box, but Julen Agirrezabala intercepts it and averts the threat.
80' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Jose Angel Carmona and he is replaced by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla).
80' Substitution. Peque is replaced by Mateo Mejia (Sevilla).
80' Peio Canales (Ath Bilbao) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
79' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

79' The free kick is delivered by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
78' Poor challenge! Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) is penalised for tripping and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
71' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Peio Canales (Ath Bilbao) replacing Alex Berenguer.
71' We are about to witness a substitution. Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is replacing Oscar de Marcos.
70' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Nico Williams. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.
66' The attendance for today's match is 48288.
65' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) swings in a cross from the corner, but Julen Agirrezabala reads it well and gathers the ball.
63' Suso (Sevilla) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
60' The resulting corner, taken by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao), comes to nothing.
59' Substitution. Suso (Sevilla) in, Kelechi Iheanacho out.
59' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Unai Gomez is replaced by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
59' Mikel Vesga goes off the pitch and Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) comes on.

59' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
55' Today's referee Cesar Soto Grado rightly decides to book Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) for his harsh tackle.
54' POST! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
52' The linesman signals that Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
47' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
47' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) takes the corner with a short pass.

46' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop. The ball is out of play and Sevilla manage to earn a corner.

46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Valentin Barco. He is replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Cesar Soto Grado has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

43' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sevilla are going to take it.

39' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Orjan Nyland makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
36' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Orjan Nyland. He makes it 1:0.
36' It seemed like Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
31' The corner by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
29' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
28' A quickly taken corner by Ath Bilbao.
28' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Ath Bilbao get a corner.
24' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) hits a shot towards the left side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Orjan Nyland.
20' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to find Inaki Williams, but he puts too much power on the pass.
14' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) took the corner.

13' Valentin Barco (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
8' Peque (Sevilla) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Julen Agirrezabala is alert and denies him with a nice save.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Sevilla will kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado is the one to supervise the game today.
